page.overview:
Who is Talaus?

Along with his brothers Areius and Leodokus, Talaus was an Argonaut. Talaus was the king of Argos and one of the Argonauts. He was the son of Bias and Pero. His wife was Lysimache, daughter of Polybus. He was the father of Adrastus, Aristomachus, Astynome, Eriphyle, Mecisteus, Metidice, and Pronax.

"From Argos came Talaus and Areius, sons of Bias, and mighty Leodocus, all of whom Pero daughter of Neleus bare..." - Apollonius of Rhodes, Argonautica 1.118 Category:Argonauts
